findings.action: the board moved 153 mm / 6.6 deg rms in the torso frame across the holds: lock the robot and the board stand, then retake
hold each pose still for ~2.5 s (11 stops were too short), cover the grid and reach each pose from both sides (the protocol's snake there and back)
camera cam2 stopped at 19 s: restart the camera producer (dma-video) and check both cameras stream before retaking
the torso shifted during the take (only 14% of the holds stood where most did): brace it harder and move the head with fingertip force
only 19 holds have a board pose step 81 can use (it needs 20): keep the whole board in view and the head still in each hold, and hold more poses
step 82 will not measure the joint axes (its R_BS still fits): nod and turn one joint at a time, faster than ~20 deg/s; a short separate take will do
the recorder fell behind (gaps in /joints; check the record pod's CPU): those holds are dropped; nothing to do unless too few holds remain
